body.objective: Students will be able to describe the weather.
successCriteria: I can ask about and describe the weather in Mandarin
I can say temperatures with 度 and 零下
I can give a simple weather forecast
body.hook: Harbin in northeast China holds a famous ice and snow festival in winter, with temperatures well below −20 °C, while Guangzhou in the south stays warm. China's weather is as varied as Canada's.

study.title: 天气怎么样?
study.question: How do I describe the weather in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Weather (written for this lesson):
Question: 今天天气怎么样? Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng? (How's the weather today?)
Answers: 今天很冷。今天很热。今天下雨。今天下雪。今天刮风。今天是晴天。今天阴天 yīntiān (cloudy).
Temperatures: 二十度 (20 degrees); 零下十五度 líng xià shíwǔ dù (−15 degrees). 今天多少度? (What's the temperature?)
Forecast: 明天会下雪。(It will snow tomorrow.) 会 here means "will likely."
Model forecast: 今天卡尔加里刮风, 零下五度。明天会下雪, 零下十二度。后天是晴天。 (Today Calgary is windy, −5 °C. Tomorrow it will snow, −12 °C. The day after tomorrow will be sunny.)
China facts: Harbin's Ice and Snow Festival is held in winter; Guangzhou has hot, humid summers and mild winters; Beijing has cold, dry winters and hot summers.
Activity: groups present a TV-style forecast in Mandarin for two Canadian and two Chinese cities using a map.
study.source: Original activity written for this lesson; climate notes are general.
steps: Say temperatures with 度 and 零下
discussion: What is the weather like today?
How is Harbin's winter like Alberta's?
How do you make a forecast?
study.product: Present a weather forecast in Mandarin for four cities with weather, temperatures and one sentence using 会.

practice.q: What does 会 mean in forecasts?
How is Harbin's winter similar to Alberta's?
practice.a: Both are very cold with snow.

practice.q: Translate: Today it's minus five and windy.
practice.a: 今天零下五度, 刮风。

items.answer: 冷, 热, 下雨, 下雪, 刮风, 晴天.
零下二十五度, 三十度.
Harbin is very cold in winter; Guangzhou is warm.

body.objective: Students will be able to name the seasons.
successCriteria: I can name the four seasons in Mandarin
I can describe weather and activities in each season
I can say which season I like and why
body.hook: Spring, summer, autumn, winter: the Chinese names for the seasons appear in poems, festivals and the traditional calendar. And every Albertan has an opinion about which season is best.

study.title: 四个季节
study.question: How do I talk about the seasons in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Seasons (written for this lesson):
一年有四个季节: 春天、夏天、秋天和冬天。
Descriptions: 春天很暖和, 常常刮风。夏天很热, 有时候下雨。秋天很凉快, 树叶变红了。冬天很冷, 常常下雪。 (Spring is warm and often windy. Summer is hot and sometimes rainy. Autumn is cool and the leaves turn red. Winter is cold and it often snows.)
Activities: 夏天我游泳。冬天我滑雪。
Favourite: 你最喜欢哪个季节? Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié? (Which season do you like most?) 我最喜欢秋天, 因为天气很凉快。
Culture: the traditional Chinese calendar divides the year into 24 solar terms (二十四节气), which guided farming; 立春 lìchūn marks the start of spring around early February.
Alberta note: 在阿尔伯塔, 冬天很长! (In Alberta, winter is long!)
Activity: make a four-panel seasons poster with weather and activities in Mandarin; then survey: 你最喜欢哪个季节? 为什么?
study.source: Original activity written for this lesson.
steps: Say your favourite season with 最 and 因为
discussion: Which season does the class like most?
How are Alberta's seasons different from southern China's?
study.product: Create a four-season poster with weather and an activity for each in Mandarin, and write why one is your favourite.

body.objective: Students will be able to compare with 比.
successCriteria: I can compare two things with A 比 B + adjective
I can add how much with 一点儿 and 得多
I can say two things are the same with 跟…一样
body.hook: "今天比昨天冷!" Comparing is natural when talking about weather: colder than yesterday, warmer than Calgary. Mandarin uses one small word for comparisons: 比 bǐ.

study.title: 比一比
study.question: How do I compare things in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Comparisons (written for this lesson):
A 比 B + adjective (no 很!): 今天比昨天冷。(Today is colder than yesterday.) 哈尔滨比广州冷。(Harbin is colder than Guangzhou.)
How much: A 比 B + adj + 一点儿 (a little): 今天比昨天冷一点儿。 A 比 B + adj + 得多 (much): 冬天比夏天冷得多。
Not as: A 没有 B + adj: 温哥华没有卡尔加里冷。(Vancouver is not as cold as Calgary.)
Same: A 跟 B 一样 + adj: 今天跟昨天一样冷。
Even more: 更: 明天会更冷。
Common mistake: don't use 很 with 比: say 今天比昨天冷, not 今天比昨天很冷.
Data activity: groups get average January temperatures for Calgary, Edmonton, Vancouver, Beijing, Harbin and Guangzhou (teacher provides from public climate data) and write six comparison sentences. Then compare other things: 我哥哥比我高。中文比英文难吗?
study.source: Original activity written for this lesson; teachers provide current climate data.
